Method of Attack: Downloading over 38MB of code from a third-party server containing tracking features logging user IP addresses, user-agent strings, domain, and page viewed
Malicious backdoor allowing remote connection to create new pages or posts
Creating hidden spammy pages with links not visible in backend and hidden from logged-in users, only shown to logged-out visitors
Contacting remote domains to retrieve content for secret spam pages
Insertion of spammy links into sites

Attack Vector: Plugin update mechanism via WordPress.org Plugins repository
Malicious code embedded in plugin versions
Remote code retrieval from third-party servers
